annotations.title: Model-Based Weather by Address (hourly forecast with hours_ahead)

description: Model-Based Weather by Address: point weather for any U.S. coordinate or street address, with current conditions, active severe weather alerts and a short-term rain outlook. FREE by default: the lean response needs no account. details=true returns the full pull, billed $0.0002 per call (not per address). Add hours_ahead=0-48 for Model-Based Hourly Forecast by Address.

address.description: Street address. Real server-side geocoding -- no separate geocoding step needed.

details.description: true = full pull, $0.0002/call, requires an API key or x402 payment. false (default) = free lean response.

hours_ahead.description: Forecast 0-48h out instead of current conditions -- snaps to the nearest available forecast hour, response's forecast_hour_used says exactly what you got.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment payload, used instead of an API key when details=true.

name: get_current_weather
